उद्देश्य: Beleg aus SWS_LINInterface (7.6.3.5 LIN TP reception).

            
7.6.3.5 LIN TP reception
The LIN Interface shall be prepared to receive TP messages anytime.
The LIN master node receives the TP message from the slaves in one or several SRFs.
The first SRF in the TP message will always be a FF or a SF.
The LIN slave node receives the TP message from the master in in one or several
MRFs. The first MRF in the TP message will always be a FF or a SF.
Since the LIN Interface does not know when an external node is starting a TP message
that the LIN Interface shall receive, it must have the possibility to store part of the TP
message.
[SWS_LinIf_00075] ⌈The LIN Interface shall call the function PduR_LinTp-
StartOfReception with an info pointer and TpSduLength when the start of a
TP message reception is indicated by the reception of a FF or a SF.
info is pointer to the buffer containing the received data (SduDataPtr) and data
length (SduLength). The data length (including SID) is 5 bytes for FF and up to 6
bytes for SF. TpSduLength is the total length of the Sdu.⌋
The output pointer parameter provides the LIN Interface with currently available receive
buffer size.
[SWS_LinIf_00076] ⌈The LIN Interface shall convert the received NAD from the trans-
mitting LIN node to an N-SDU Id that the upper layer understands.⌋
[SWS_LinIf_00674] ⌈After reception of each frame of a TP message (SF, FF and
CF), the LIN Interface shall call the function PduR_LinTpCopyRxData with an info
pointer containing received data (SduDataPtr) and data length (SduLength). The
data length is 5 bytes (including SID) for FF, up to 6 bytes for SF and 6 bytes for CF (or
less in case of the last CF).⌋
The output pointer parameter provides the LIN Interface with available receive buffer
size after data have been copied.
[SWS_LinIf_00078]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Lin_01564
⌈When the LIN Interface has received the SF or the last CF of a TP message success-
fully, it shall request a schedule table change to the applicative schedule by calling the
function BswM_LinTp_RequestMode with the parameter LINTP_APPLICATIVE_-
SCHEDULE (see [SWS_LinIf_00646]).
After successful completion or failure (e.g.,
since some other schedule table change is currently going on) of the schedule table
switch, the LIN Interface shall notify the upper layer by calling the function PduR_-
LinTpRxIndication with the result E_OK.⌋

उद्देश्य: Beleg aus SWS_LINInterface (7.6.3 Diagnostics – Transport Protocol).

            
7.6.3 Diagnostics – Transport Protocol
In the ISO 17987 specifications, the Transport Protocol (TP) is optional to implement.
There are three types of diagnostics defined:
• Signal Based diagnostics
• User Defined diagnostics
• Diagnostic Transport Layer
It is only relevant to support the Diagnostic Transport Layer in the LIN Interface (and
this is what is called the LIN TP). The Signal Based diagnostics has no meaning since
signals are not defined here. The User Defined diagnostics shall not be used since all
Diagnostic communication shall use the Diagnostic Transport Layer.
[SWS_LinIf_00313]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Lin_01579
⌈The LIN Interface shall support the Diagnostic Transport Layer (defined in the ISO
17987 specifications) without the contained Diagnostic API which represents the LIN
TP.⌋
The support of the LIN TP shall be configurable on/off to make the LIN Interface
smaller when LIN TP is not used.
[SWS_LinIf_00387]
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00171
⌈The support for the LIN TP shall be pre-compile time configurable by the configura-
tion parameter LinIfTpSupported.⌋
It is possible that the LIN Interface has more than one channel (connected to more
than one LIN cluster).
[SWS_LinIf_00314]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Lin_01574
⌈The LIN Interface shall support the transfer of a LIN TP message on each separate
channel and they shall be independent of each other.⌋
The designer of the schedule tables has to include master request and slave response
frames. Otherwise, LIN TP transfer stalls.
The LIN TP is used to transport diagnostic service requests and responses. Func-
tional diagnostic requests are possible in parallel to physical requests or responses.
[SWS_LinIf_00062]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Lin_01534, SRS_Lin_01592
⌈LIN Interface shall support physical (only half-duplex) and functional TP connections
on one channel at the same time, while only one physical TP connection can be active
at a time.⌋

8.2.10 LinIf_SetTrcvWakeupMode
[SWS_LinIf_00550] Definition of API function LinIf_SetTrcvWakeupMode
Upstream requirements: SRS_Lin_01589
⌈
Service Name
LinIf_SetTrcvWakeupMode
Syntax
Std_ReturnType LinIf_SetTrcvWakeupMode (
NetworkHandleType Channel,
LinTrcv_TrcvWakeupModeType LinTrcvWakeupMode
)
Service ID [hex]
0x0b
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
Channel
Identification of the LIN channel
Parameters (in)
LinTrcvWakeupMode
Requested transceiver wake up reason.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: The call of the LIN Transceiver Driver’s API service has
returned E_OK.
E_NOT_OK: The call of the LIN Transceiver Driver’s API service
has returned E_NOT_OK or channel or mode parameter is invalid.
Description
This API enables, disables and clears the notification for wakeup events on the addressed
network
Available via
LinIf.h
⌋
[SWS_LinIf_00551] ⌈This API shall enable, disable or clear the notification for wake
up events on the addressed network by calling the underlying function LinTrcv_-
SetWakeupMode(LinNetwork, TrcvWakeupMode).⌋
[SWS_LinIf_00595] ⌈If development error detection is enabled and an invalid value for
Channel is given, the function LinIf_SetTrcvWakeupMode shall report LINIF_
E_NONEXISTENT_CHANNEL to the default error tracer.⌋
[SWS_LinIf_00596] ⌈If development error detection is enabled and an invalid value
for LinTrcvWakeupMode is given, the function LinIf_SetTrcvWakeupMode shall
report LINIF_E_PARAMETER to the default error tracer.⌋
[SWS_LinIf_00637] ⌈The function LinIf_SetTrcvWakeupMode is required only if
at least one LIN channel uses the LIN transceiver driver. This function shall be pre-
compile time configurable On/Off by the configuration parameter LinIfTrcvDriver-
Supported.⌋
Caveats:
• The LIN Interface has to be initialized with a call of LinIf_Init before this API
service may be called, see [SRS_BSW_00487].
• The implementation may be e.g. disabling the interrupt source for the wake up.
If the interrupt is level triggered a pending interrupt is automatically stored and
raised after enabling the notification again. It is very important not to lose wake
up events during the disabled period.

8.2.11 LinIf_GetPIDTable
The service LinIf_GetPIDTable is only applicable to LIN slave node (available only
if the ECU has any LIN slave channel).
[SWS_LinIf_91002] Definition of API function LinIf_GetPIDTable ⌈
Service Name
LinIf_GetPIDTable
Syntax
Std_ReturnType LinIf_GetPIDTable (
NetworkHandleType Channel,
Lin_FramePidType* PidBuffer,
uint8* PidBufferLength
)
Service ID [hex]
0x72
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
Parameters (in)
Channel
Identification of the LIN channel.
PidBuffer
Pointer to existing buffer to which the current assigned PID values
are copied to
Parameters (inout)
PidBufferLength
Pointer to actual length of provided buffer. After successful return,
it contains the number of copied PID values.
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: Request has been accepted.
E_NOT_OK: Request has not been accepted, development or
production error occurred.
▽
△
Description
Retrieves all assigned PID values. The order is congruent to the LIN frame index.
Only applicable for LIN slave nodes.
Available via
LinIf.h
⌋
[SWS_LinIf_00816] ⌈This API shall return the configured PIDs of all frames relevant
for the slave node. The order shall be ascending corresponding to the configuration
parameter LinIfFrameIndex. The value of PidBufferLength shall be updated
with the actual number of configured PIDs.⌋
[SWS_LinIf_00817] ⌈The returned PID list shall not include the PIDs for MRF and
SRF.⌋
Rationale: MRF and SRF are always implicitly assigned to each slave node and their
PIDs shall not be changed (see also [SWS_LinIf_00809]).
[SWS_LinIf_00828] ⌈If the length of the buffer (provided by parameter PidBuffer-
Length) is 0, the function shall return the number of configured PIDs of the slave node
in parameter PidBufferLength, without updating the PID buffer with PIDs.⌋
[SWS_LinIf_00818] ⌈If development error detection is enabled and an invalid value
for Channel is given, the function LinIf_GetPIDTable shall report LINIF_E_-
NONEXISTENT_CHANNEL to the default error tracer.⌋
[SWS_LinIf_00819] ⌈If development error detection is enabled and an invalid value for
PidBuffer is given, the function LinIf_GetPIDTable shall raise the development
error code LINIF_E_PARAM_POINTER.⌋
[SWS_LinIf_00820] ⌈If development error detection is enabled and an invalid value
for PidBufferLength is given, the function LinIf_GetPIDTable shall raise the
development error code LINIF_E_PARAM_POINTER.⌋
[SWS_LinIf_00821] ⌈If development error detection is enabled and length of the buffer
(provided by parameter PidBufferLength) is smaller than the number of configured
PIDs of the slave node (except 0, see [SWS_LinIf_00828]), the function LinIf_Get-
PIDTable shall raise the development error code LINIF_E_PARAMETER.⌋
[SWS_LinIf_00859] ⌈The function LinIf_GetPIDTable is only available if the LinIf
module is configured as LIN slave node on at least one channel. In a pure LIN master
configuration, this function is not available. This depends on the configuration parame-
ter LinIfNodeType.⌋

Parameters (out)
TrcvWuReasonPtr
Pointer to a memory location where output value will be stored.
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: The call of the LIN Transceiver Driver’s API service has
returned E_OK.
E_NOT_OK: The call of the LIN Transceiver Driver’s API service
has returned E_NOT_OK or channel parameter is invalid or pointer
is NULL.
Description
Returns the reason for the wake up that has been detected by the LIN Transceiver Driver.
Available via
LinIf.h
⌋
[SWS_LinIf_00548] ⌈This API shall return the reason for the wake up that the
LIN Transceiver Driver has detected by invoking the underlying function LinTrcv_-
GetBusWuReason(LinNetwork, Reason) for the corresponding requested LIN
transceiver.⌋
[SWS_LinIf_00549] ⌈If development error detection is enabled and an invalid value
for Channel is given, the function LinIf_GetTrcvWakeupReason shall report
LINIF_E_NONEXISTENT_CHANNEL to the default error tracer.⌋
[SWS_LinIf_00573] ⌈If development error detection is enabled and the parameter Tr-
cvWuReasonPtr has an invalid value, the function LinIf_GetTrcvWakeupReason
shall raise the development error code LINIF_E_PARAM_POINTER.⌋
[SWS_LinIf_00572] ⌈If development error detection is enabled and the current mode
is not LINTRCV_TRCV_MODE_NORMAL, the function LinIf_GetTrcvWakeupReason
shall report LINIF_E_TRCV_NOT_NORMAL to the default error tracer.⌋
[SWS_LinIf_00636] ⌈The function LinIf_GetTrcvWakeupReason is required only
if at least one LIN channel uses the LIN transceiver driver. This function shall be pre-
compile time configurable On/Off by the configuration parameter LinIfTrcvDriver-
Supported.⌋
Caveats:
• The LIN Interface has to be initialized with a call of LinIf_Init before this API
service may be called, see [SRS_BSW_00487].
• Please be aware, that if more than one network is available, each network may
report a different wake up reason. This API has a“per network” view and does not
vote the more important reason or sequence internally. The same may be true if
e.g. one transceiver controls the power supply and the other is just powered or
un-powered. Then one may be able to return LINTRCV_WU_POWER_ON, whereas
the other may state e.g. LINTRCV_WU_RESET.
It is up to the EcuM to decide how to handle that wake up information.

उद्देश्य: Beleg aus SWS_LINInterface (8.5.3 Configurable interfaces).

            
8.5.3 Configurable interfaces
In this section, all interfaces are listed, where the target function of any upper layer to
be called has to be set up by configuration. These call-out services are specified and
implemented in the upper communication modules, which use the LIN Interface accord-
ing to the AUTOSAR BSW architecture. The specific call-out notification is specified in
the corresponding SWS document (see Chapter 3 “Related documentation”).
As far the interface name is not specified to be mandatory, no call-out is performed, if
no API name is configured. This section describes only the content of notification of
the call-out, the call context inside the LIN Interface and exact time by the call event.
_NotificationName – This condition is applied for such interface services
that will be implemented in the upper layer (‘user’) and called by the LIN Interface. This
condition displays the symbolic name of the functional group in a call-out service in
the corresponding upper layer. Each upper layer can define no, one or several call-out
services for the same functionality (i.e. transmit confirmation).

Wakeup from within the wake-up ISR of the corresponding LIN channel when a valid
LIN wake-up pulse has been detected.⌋
Restrictions:
A wake-up ISR can only be raised if supported by the LIN hardware (with or without
Icu; up to the LIN driver implementation and the LIN hardware design). Therefore, Ecu
M_CheckWakeup is supported if at least for one channel wake-up is supported (see
configuration parameter LinChannelWakeupSupport).

उद्देश्य: Beleg aus SWS_LINInterface (9.1.2 Frame transmission in slave nodes).

            
9.1.2 Frame transmission in slave nodes
This section is only applicable to LIN slave nodes.
The following use case (Figure 9.3) shows the transmission of a LIN frame.
After
a received LIN header is indicated by the LIN driver, the PID is evaluated (shown by
function EvaluatePID). If it’s determined to belong to a transmission frame, the trans-
mission response data is requested from upper layer. The buffer to which SduPtr
member in PduPtr parameter points to can be directly passed to let the upper layer
copy the transmission data to the provided buffer. The LIN interface informs the driver
about the response type by setting the appropriate members of PduPtr (shown by
function SetPduPtrValues).
The CopyBuffer call is to show that the copying of the SDU is made in the LIN Driver
and not in the LIN Interface.

9.2.5 FlexRay Wakeup Sequences
For FlexRay a wake up is only possible via the FlexRay transceivers. There are two
transceivers for the two different channels in a FlexRay cluster. They are treated as
belonging to one network and thus, there should be only one wake up source identifier
configured for both channels. Figure 9.11 shows the FlexRay transceiver wakeup via
interrupt. The interrupt is usually handled by the ICU Driver as described in Chapter
9.2.2.

9.3.2 Irrelevant communication in slave nodes
This section is only applicable to LIN slave nodes.
The third direction for a LIN frame is that the frame is not relevant for the slave node
and is ignored. After a received LIN header is indicated by the LIN driver, the PID
is evaluated (shown by function EvaluatePID). If it’s determined to belong to an
Irrelevant frame, the LIN interface informs the driver about the response type by
setting the appropriate members of PduPtr (shown by function SetPduPtrValues).
No further action is made (Figure 9.7).

उद्देश्य: Beleg aus SWS_LINInterface (9.4 Sporadic frame (Master only)).

            
9.4 Sporadic frame (Master only)
This section is only applicable to LIN master nodes. For LIN slave nodes, Sporadic
frames are handled like reception of Unconditional frames.
The following use case (Figure 9.8) shows an upper layer requesting transmission of
a Sporadic frame. Actually, this call does not initiate the transmission of the frame
since the schedule table must be followed. It just marks the frame for transmission.
When the Sporadic slot (note that the schedule entry for a Sporadic frame is
a slot and not a frame) is due in the schedule table, the LinIf_MainFunction_
 transmits the Sporadic frame as a normal trans-
mitted frame and according to the priority rules for Sporadic frames.
The CheckId function is to show that the LIN Interface must check what frame is
passed (convert the ID from the upper layer to the correct PID) from the upper layer.
The SetFlag function is a local function to flag the Sporadic frame for transmission
in the LIN Interface. There is one flag for each Sporadic frame.

उद्देश्य: Beleg aus SWS_LINInterface (9.5.2 Event-triggered frame in slave nodes).

            
9.5.2 Event-triggered frame in slave nodes
This section is only applicable to LIN slave nodes.
The following use case (Figure 9.12) shows an upper layer requesting transmission
of an Event-triggered frame. It just marks the frame for transmission. When
the header of the Event-triggered frame is received for which the associated
response is pending, the transmission is requested from upper layer like for an uncon-
ditional transmission frame.
The CheckId function is to show that the LIN Interface must check what frame is
passed (convert the ID from the upper layer to the correct PID) from the upper layer.
The SetFlag function is a local function to flag the Event-triggered frame for
transmission in the LIN Interface.
There is one flag for each Event-triggered
frame.
The CopyPID function is to show that that the LIN Interface must copy the PID of the
requested Event-triggered frame to the first byte of the payload data.
The ClearFlag function is a local function to clear the pending flag of an Event-
triggered frame after successful transmission.

उद्देश्य: Beleg aus SWS_LINInterface (9.6 Transport Protocol message transmission).

            
9.6 Transport Protocol message transmission
The following diagram (Figure 9.13) shows the transmission of a TP message. The
initiation of the message, the continuous copying of the data and the finish of the mes-
sage are shown. The actual transmission of the MRF/SRF is not shown in the diagram
and it has the same behavior as frame transmission.
The TP message start is always initiated by requesting to send the TP message from
the PDU Router. For LIN master nodes, the schedule table change to the diagnostic re-
quest schedule is requested if a schedule table change is enabled by the configuration
parameter (see the parameter LinTpScheduleChangeDiag).
The TP message is finished after the last N-PDU (SF or CF) is transmitted. The PDU
Router is notified of the completion of the message transmission.
For LIN master
nodes, the schedule table change to the diagnostic response schedule is requested if
a schedule table change is enabled by the configuration parameter (see the parameter
LinTpScheduleChangeDiag).

उद्देश्य: Beleg aus SWS_LINStateManager (7.1.3 LINSM_NO_COM).

            
7.1.3 LINSM_NO_COM
The no communication state is active after initialization and when the ComM module
requests no communication (LIN master node) or when the LinIf indicates a bus sleep
event (LIN slave node).
[SWS_LinSM_00026] ⌈There shall be a sub-state called LINSM_NO_COM in the state
LINSM_INIT.⌋
[SWS_LinSM_00027] ⌈When entering LINSM_NO_COM the LinSM module shall no-
tify (with the exception [SWS_LinSM_00166]) ComM of the state change by calling the
ComM_BusSM_ModeIndication with the parameter COMM_NO_COMMUNICATION
for the specific network.⌋
[SWS_LinSM_00193] ⌈When entering LINSM_NO_COM the LinSM module shall no-
tify (with the exception [SWS_LinSM_00166]) BswM of the state change by calling the
BswM_LinSM_CurrentState with the parameter LINSM_NO_COM for the specific net-
work.⌋
There is one exception to the above two requirements. The rationale is that the ComM
may not be initialized when executing the LinSM_Init function.
[SWS_LinSM_00166] ⌈The LinSM module shall not notify the state change to LINSM_
NO_COM when the LinSM is executing the LinSM_Init function, i.e. the LinSM_Init
function shall neither call ComM_BusSM_ModeIndication nor BswM_LinSM_Current
State.⌋
[SWS_LinSM_00028] ⌈When LINSM_NO_COM is active, the LinSM module shall not
command the LinIf module to communicate for the selected network, i.e. bus shall be
silent.
Note: Upon entering or exiting the LINSM_NO_COM state the LinSM module will not
set the hardware interface or µ-controller into a new power mode. This is not in the
scope of the LinSM⌋
[SWS_LinSM_00203] ⌈When entering LINSM_NO_COM the transceiver shall be set
to STANDBY if LinSMTransceiverPassiveMode is true and SLEEP otherwise by using
the LinIf_SetTrcvMode. This requirement is applicable only when LinSMTransceiver
PassiveMode is configured for the channel.⌋
[SWS_LinSM_00204] ⌈The LinIf_SetTrcvMode shall not be called from the function
LinSM_Init.
Note: There is no need to set the mode in the LinSM init function since the Transceiver
will set the mode in its init function. The mode is selected in the Transceiver configura-
tion.⌋

lowed. Each network can be in LINSM_FULL_COM independent of each other. All of
the following requirements are applicable for each network.

fied of the state change by calling the ComM_BusSM_ModeIndication with the param-
eter COMM_FULL_COMMUNICATION for the specified network.⌋
[SWS_LinSM_00192] ⌈When entering LINSM_FULL_COM the BswM shall be noti-
fied of the state change by calling the BswM_LinSM_CurrentState with the parameter
LINSM_FULL_COM for the specified network.⌋
[SWS_LinSM_00205] ⌈When entering LINSM_FULL_COM the transceiver shall be
set to active by using the LinIf_SetTrcvMode. This requirement is applicable only when
LinSMTransceiverPassiveMode is configured for the channel.⌋
[SWS_LinSM_00301] ⌈When entering LINSM_FULL_COM, the sub-state LINSM_
RUN_COMMUNICATION will be entered.⌋

उद्देश्य: Beleg aus SWS_LINStateManager (7.1.8 Timeout of requests).

            
7.1.8 Timeout of requests
After calling LinIf_Wakeup the LinSM module is waiting for the LinIf module to confirm
the wake up on the bus. There is a possibility that the confirmation is not received, and
therefore the LinSM module will wait forever.
The cause for a missing wakeup confirmation could be a problem in software, but also
a bus failure or a problem in the master node. A slave node confirms a bus wakeup not
after wakeup transmission like a master node, but with reception of the first LIN header
from the master node. A LIN slave node shall repeat the wakeup frame transmission up
to three times if the communication does not start. After three (failing) wakeup requests
the node shall wait a minimum time before restarting the wake up process.
[SWS_LinSM_00175] ⌈There shall be independent wakeup confirmation timers for
each network.⌋
[SWS_LinSM_00162] ⌈The (countdown and expiration) handling of wakeup confirma-
tion timers shall be done in the LinSM_MainFunction.⌋
[SWS_LinSM_00159] ⌈The wakeup confirmation timeout parameter LinSMConfirma-
tionTimeout shall have a time that is either 0 or divisible by the LinSM_MainFunction
(i.e. LinSM_MainFunction period * m; m integer >0).⌋
[SWS_LinSM_00100] ⌈Before the LinSM calls LinIf_Wakeup on a channel it shall start
a wakeup confirmation timer for the according channel with the configured timeout
parameter LinSMConfirmationTimeout if LinSMConfirmationTimeout > 0.⌋
[SWS_LinSM_00154] ⌈If LinSM_WakeupConfirmation is called on a channel before
the wakeup confirmation timer has expired on the according channel LinSM shall stop
the timer.⌋
[SWS_LinSM_00102] ⌈If a wakeup confirmation timer elapses (i.e. no wakeup con-
firmation occurred) and the maximum number of retries (LinSMModeRequestRepeti-
tionMax) has been reached and LinSMDevErrorDetect (ECUC_LinSM_00206) is set to
TRUE, the LinSM module shall report LINSM_E_CONFIRMATION_TIMEOUT to DET.⌋
Making the timeout optional enhances implementation size, if the timeout is not re-
quired:
Note: If the configuration parameter LinSMConfirmationTimeout is set to zero the
wakeup confirmation timer is not used, and hence a timeout cannot occur. This means
that requirement [SWS_LinSM_00102] will not happen.
[SWS_LinSM_00304] ⌈If a wakeup confirmation timer elapses (i.e. no wakeup con-
firmation occurred), LinSMNodeType is set to MASTER and ComM request is still
COMM_FULL_COMMUNICATION then LinIf_Wakeup shall be called.⌋
Note:
LinSM stops to retry when confirmation callback LinSM_WakeupConfirma-
tion ([SWS_LinSM_00132]) occurs or timeout parameter LinSMConfirmationTimeout
(ECUC_LinSM_00144) is expired and ComM requests COMM_NO_COMMUNICA-
TION.
[SWS_LinSM_00235] ⌈If a wakeup confirmation timer elapses (i.e. no wakeup con-
firmation occurred), the maximum number of retries (LinSMModeRequestRepetition
Max) has not been reached, LinSMNodeType is set to Slave and ComM request is still
COMM_FULL_COMMUNICATION then LinIf_Wakeup shall be called.⌋
[SWS_LinSM_00236] ⌈If a wakeup confirmation timer elapses (i.e. no wakeup con-
firmation occurred), the maximum number of retries (LinSMModeRequestRepetition
Max) has been reached, LinSMNodeType is set to Slave then LinSM shall wait the
silence-after-wakeup time (LinSMSilenceAfterWakeupTimeout) and afterwards restart
the wakeup process by
• calling LinIf_Wakeup if ComM request is still COMM_FULL_COMMUNICATION.
• resetting the counter for maximum number of retries.
⌋
[SWS_LinSM_00237] ⌈If a wakeup confirmation timer elapses (i.e. no wakeup confir-
mation occurred), the maximum number of retries (LinSMModeRequestRepetitionMax)
has been reached, LinSMNodeType is set to Slave, the silence-after-wakeup time (Lin
SMSilenceAfterWakeupTimeout) has not expired and ComM requests COMM_FULL_
COMMUNICATION then the call of LinIf_Wakeup shall be delayed to the expiration of
the silence-after-wakeup time.⌋

उद्देश्य: Beleg aus SWS_LINStateManager (7.2 Handling multiple networks and drivers).

            
7.2 Handling multiple networks and drivers
Usually only one LIN driver module (supporting multiple networks) is needed in an
ECU to handle all LIN networks. However, rarely, some hardware configurations the
ECU contain different LIN hardware (e.g. an advanced LIN controller and a UART). In
such case, more than one different LIN drivers are required. This will not affect the Lin
SM module since the LIN driver only interfaces the LinIf module and not the LIN driver
module directly.
The LinSM will only handle networks, and is not concerned to which driver the network
maps to, this will be handled by the LinIf.

उद्देश्य: Beleg aus SWS_LINTransceiverDriver (7.2 LIN transceiver hardware operation modes).

            
7.2 LIN transceiver hardware operation modes
The LIN transceiver hardware may support more mode transitions than the software.
The dependencies and the recommended implementations behaviour are explained in
this chapter.
It is up to the implementation to decide which LIN transceiver hardware state is covered
by which LIN transceiver driver software state. An implementation has to guarantee
that whole functionality of described LIN transceiver driver is given by the implementa-
tion.

उद्देश्य: Beleg aus SWS_LINTransceiverDriver (7.4 LIN transceiver wakeup modes).

            
7.4 LIN transceiver wakeup modes
[SWS_LinTrcv_00066]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Lin_01514, SRS_Lin_01563
⌈Wakeup notification must be supported by LIN Transceiver driver, therefore LIN
transceiver driver covers 2 wakeup modes, internal wakeup by an upper layer or exter-
nal wakeup by LIN channel.⌋
1. Internal wakeup: An internal wakeup is initiated by an upper layer, e.g. by calling
LinTrcv_Init or LinTrcv_SetOpMode.
2. External wakeup: Wakeup detected by LIN transceiver driver is forwarded to the
upper layer through the API LinTrcv_CheckWakeup which has to be called by
the LinIf.
Hint: WakeUp through ISR is not supported by the LIN Transceiver Driver but is only
possible through ICU.
[SWS_LinTrcv_00074]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Lin_01580
⌈Selection of wakeup mode shall be done by configuration parameter LinTrcvWake-
UpSupport.⌋
[SWS_LinTrcv_00075]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Lin_01580
⌈Support of wakeup shall be switched on and off for each LIN transceiver channel
individually by configuration parameter LinTrcvWakeupByBusUsed.⌋
[SWS_LinTrcv_00161] ⌈LinTrcv driver shall use the following APIs provided by ICU
driver, to enable and disable the wakeup event notification:
• Icu_EnableNotification
• Icu_DisableNotification
⌋
[SWS_LinTrcv_00162] ⌈LinTrcv driver shall enable the ICU channels when the
transceiver transmits to standby mode (LINTRCV_STANDBY)⌋
[SWS_LinTrcv_00163] ⌈LinTrcv driver shall disable the ICU channels when the
transceiver transmits to Normal mode (LINTRCV_NORMAL)⌋
Rationale: LinTrcv driver shall avoid the loss of wakeup events.

8.3.2 LinTrcv_SetOpMode
[SWS_LinTrcv_00002] Definition of API function LinTrcv_SetOpMode
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00310, SRS_BSW_00357, SRS_BSW_00369, SRS_BSW_
00406, SRS_Lin_01566, SRS_Lin_01524
⌈
Service Name
LinTrcv_SetOpMode
Syntax
Std_ReturnType LinTrcv_SetOpMode (
uint8 LinNetwork,
LinTrcv_TrcvModeType OpMode
)
Service ID [hex]
0x01
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant
LinNetwork
LIN network to wich API call has to be applied
Parameters (in)
OpMode
The parameter says to which operation mode the change shall be
performed.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: will be returned if the transceiver state has been changed
to the requested mode.
E_NOT_OK: will be returned if the transceiver state change is not
accepted or has failed or the parameter is out of the allowed
range.
Description
The internal state of the LIN transceiver driver is switched to mode given in the parameter Op
Mode.
Available via
LinTrcv.h
⌋
[SWS_LinTrcv_00108] ⌈The function LinTrcv_SetOpMode shall switch the internal
state of channel LinNetwork to the value of the parameter OpMode which can be LIN-
TRCV_TRCV_MODE_NORMAL, LINTRCV_TRCV_MODE_STANDBY or LINTRCV_
TRCV_MODE_SLEEP.⌋
[SWS_LinTrcv_00109] ⌈The function LinTrcv_SetOpMode shall switch the internal
state of channel LinNetwork to the value of LINTRCV_TRCV_MODE_STANDBY if
one of the following conditions is fulfilled:
a) the channel LinNetwork is in mode LINTRCV_TRCV_MODE_SLEEP and the op-
tional transition from this mode to LINTRCV_TRCV_MODE_STANDBY is enabled.
b) the channel LinNetwork is in mode LINTRCV_TRCV_MODE_NORMAL and the
optional transition from this mode to LINTRCV_TRCV_MODE_STANDBY is enabled.⌋
[SWS_LinTrcv_00110] ⌈The function LinTrcv_SetOpMode shall switch the internal
state of channel LinNetwork to the value of LINTRCV_TRCV_MODE_SLEEP if one
of the following conditions is fulfilled:
a) the channel LinNetwork is in mode LINTRCV_TRCV_MODE_NORMAL
b) the channel LinNetwork is in mode LINTRCV_TRCV_MODE_STANDBY and the
optional transition from this mode to LINTRCV_TRCV_MODE_SLEEP is enabled.⌋
[SWS_LinTrcv_00147] ⌈The function LinTrcv_SetOpMode shall switch the internal
state of channel LinNetwork to the value of LINTRCV_TRCV_MODE_NORMAL if
one of the following conditions is fulfilled:
a) the channel LinNetwork is in mode LINTRCV_TRCV_MODE_SLEEP
b) the channel LinNetwork is in mode LINTRCV_TRCV_MODE_STANDBY and the
optional transition from this mode to LINTRCV_TRCV_MODE_NORMAL is enabled.⌋
[SWS_LinTrcv_00111] ⌈This API is applicable to each transceiver with each value
for parameter LinTrcv_SetOpMode regardless of whether the transceiver hardware
supports these modes or not. This is to simplify the view of the LinIf to the assigned
bus.⌋
[SWS_LinTrcv_00112] ⌈If the requested mode is not supported by the underlying
transceiver hardware, the function LinTrcv_SetOpMode shall return E_NOT_OK.⌋
[SWS_LinTrcv_00113] ⌈If there is no / incorrect communication to the transceiver, the
function LinTrcv_SetOpMode shall return E_NOT_OK.⌋
[SWS_LinTrcv_00114] ⌈If development error detection for the module LinTrcv is en-
abled:
If the function LinTrcv_SetOpMode is called with OpMode == LINTRCV_TRCV_
MODE_STANDBY and the channel LinNetwork is in mode LINTRCV_SLEEP but
the optional transition from LINTRCV_SLEEP to LINTRCV_STANDBY is not enabled,
the function LinTrcv_SetOpMode shall report the development error LINTRCV_E_
INVALID_TRCV_OPMODE.⌋
[SWS_LinTrcv_00148] ⌈If development error detection for the module LinTrcv is en-
abled:
If the function LinTrcv_SetOpMode is called with OpMode == LINTRCV_TRCV_
MODE_STANDBY and the channel LinNetwork is in mode LINTRCV_NORMAL
but the optional transition from LINTRCV_NORMAL to LINTRCV_STANDBY is not

8.3.4 LinTrcv_GetBusWuReason
[SWS_LinTrcv_00007] Definition of API function LinTrcv_GetBusWuReason
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00310, SRS_BSW_00369, SRS_BSW_00377, SRS_BSW_
00406
⌈
Service Name
LinTrcv_GetBusWuReason
Syntax
Std_ReturnType LinTrcv_GetBusWuReason (
uint8 LinNetwork,
LinTrcv_TrcvWakeupReasonType* Reason
)
Service ID [hex]
0x03
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
Parameters (in)
LinNetwork
LIN network to which API call has to be applied
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
Reason
Pointer to wakeup reason of the bus the API is applied to.
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: will be returned if the wake up reason is detected
E_NOT_OK: will be returned, if service request is failed due to
wakeup reason is not detected.
Description
This API provides the reason for the wakeup that the LIN transceiver has detected in the
parameter "Reason". The ability to detect and differentiate the possible wakeup reasons
depends strongly on the LIN transceiver hardware.
Available via
LinTrcv.h
⌋
[SWS_LinTrcv_00126] ⌈The function LinTrcv_GetBusWuReason shall return the
reason for the wake up that the LIN transceiver has detected in the parameter Rea-
son.⌋
[SWS_LinTrcv_00127] ⌈If there is no / incorrect communication to the transceiver, the
function LinTrcv_GetBusWuReason shall return E_NOT_OK.⌋
[SWS_LinTrcv_00128] ⌈If development error detection for the module LinTrcv is en-
abled:
If called before the LinTrcv module has been initialized, the function LinTrcv_Get-
BusWuReason shall report development error LINTRCV_E_UNINIT.⌋
[SWS_LinTrcv_00129] ⌈If development error detection for the module LinTrcv is en-
abled:
If called with an invalid network number LinNetwork, the function LinTrcv_-
GetBusWuReason shall report development error LINTRCV_E_INVALID_LIN_NET-
WORK.⌋
[SWS_LinTrcv_00130] ⌈If development error detection for the module LinTrcv is en-
abled:
If called with Reason == NULL, the function LinTrcv_GetBusWuReason shall report
the development error LINTRCV_E_PARAM_POINTER.⌋
Configuration: The number of supported busses is statically set in the configuration
phase.
Caveats: Be aware that if more than one bus is available each bus may report a dif-
ferent wakeup reason. E.g. if an ECU has LIN, a wakeup by LIN may occur and the
incoming data may cause an internal wakeup for another LIN bus.
The LIN transceiver driver has a "per bus" view and does not vote the more important
reason or sequence internally. The same may be true if e.g. one transceiver controls
the power supply and the other is just powered or un-powered.

network.

[SWS_LinTrcv_00135] ⌈Enabled: If the function LinTrcv_SetWakeupMode is called
with TrcvWakupMode == LINTRCV_WUMODE_ENABLE and if the LinTrcv module
has a stored wakeup event pending for the addressed bus, the LinTrcv module shall
execute the notification within the API call or immediately after (depending on the im-
plementation).⌋
[SWS_LinTrcv_00136] ⌈Disabled:
If the function LinTrcv_SetWakeupMode is
called with TrcvWakupMode == LINTRCV_WUMODE_DISABLE, then the notifica-
tions for wakeup events are disabled on the addressed network.
It is required by
the transceiver device and the underlying communication driver to detect the wakeup
events and store it internally in order to raise the event when the wakeup notification is
enabled again.⌋
[SWS_LinTrcv_00137] ⌈Clear: If the function LinTrcv_SetWakeupMode is called
with TrcvWakupMode == LINTRCV_WUMODE_CLEAR, then a stored wakeup event
is cleared on the addressed network. Clearing of wakeup events have to be used when
the wake up notification is disabled to clear all stored wake up events under control of
the higher layer.⌋
[SWS_LinTrcv_00138] ⌈If there is no / incorrect communication to the transceiver, the
function LinTrcv_SetWakeupMode shall return E_NOT_OK.⌋
[SWS_LinTrcv_00139] ⌈If development error detection for the module LinTrcv is en-
abled:

abled:

WakeupMode shall report development error LINTRCV_E_INVALID_LIN_NETWORK.⌋

<h4>सिस्टम आर्किटेक्चर और मॉड्यूल क्लस्टर की भूमिका</h4>
<p>यह Cluster हार्डवेयर से लेकर मोड प्रबंधन तक Classic Platform का LIN संचार स्टैक बनाता है। चारों मॉड्यूल कार्यों को निम्नानुसार विभाजित करते हैं:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Lin</strong> MCAL driver है। यह LIN controller या UART को encapsulate करता है और classic या enhanced checksum <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_00019" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_00019">[SWS_Lin_00019]</a> की गणना करता है। यह frames को PID, checksum model, response type, length और SDU pointer <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_00232" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_00232">[SWS_Lin_00232]</a> के साथ <code>Lin_PduType</code> के रूप में स्वीकार करता है।</li>
<li><strong>LinTrcv</strong> modes <code>LINTRCV_TRCV_MODE_NORMAL</code>, <code>…_STANDBY</code> और <code>…_SLEEP</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinTrcv_00168" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinTrcv_00168">[SWS_LinTrcv_00168]</a> के माध्यम से external transceiver को नियंत्रित करता है और wakeup events <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinTrcv_00012" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinTrcv_00012">[SWS_LinTrcv_00012]</a> की जांच करता है।</li>
<li><strong>LinIf</strong> hardware abstraction है। यह schedule tables और channel states को प्रबंधित करता है और इसमें transport protocol LinTp <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00350" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00350">[SWS_LinIf_00350]</a> शामिल है।</li>
<li><strong>LinSM</strong>, ComM के mode requests को लागू करता है <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_00126" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_00126">[SWS_LinSM_00126]</a> और BswM को state और schedule की रिपोर्ट करता है <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_00229" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_00229">[SWS_LinSM_00229]</a>।</li>
</ul>
<p>Node role कॉन्फ़िगरेशन द्वारा यह निर्धारित करती है कि कोई module कौन-से functions प्रदान करता है:</p>
<ul>
<li>केवल master में <code>Lin_SendFrame</code>, <code>Lin_GoToSleep</code> और <code>Lin_GetStatus</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_00287" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_00287">[SWS_Lin_00287]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_00288" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_00288">[SWS_Lin_00288]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_00289" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_00289">[SWS_Lin_00289]</a> के साथ-साथ <code>LinSM_ScheduleRequest</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_00241" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_00241">[SWS_LinSM_00241]</a> उपलब्ध होते हैं।</li>
<li>केवल slave में LinIf के driver callbacks <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00863" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00863">[SWS_LinIf_00863]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00866" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00866">[SWS_LinIf_00866]</a> और <code>LinSM_GotoSleepIndication</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_00243" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_00243">[SWS_LinSM_00243]</a> उपलब्ध होते हैं।</li>
<li>Slaves के लिए LinIf, ISO 17987-3 <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00767" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00767">[SWS_LinIf_00767]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00778" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00778">[SWS_LinIf_00778]</a> <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_LINIF_SECTION_7_6_2_4_Node_Configuration_Handler.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_LINIF_SECTION_7_6_2_4_Node_Configuration_Handler">LinIf-SWS पृ. 59</a> के node model के अनुसार NAD और PIDs को भी प्रबंधित करता है।</li>
</ul>

<p class="diagram-note">Context diagram: Cluster के modules, ComM/BswM/PduR और hardware के बीच स्थित हैं; wakeup events अतिरिक्त रूप से EcuM के माध्यम से चलते हैं। स्रोत: <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_00126" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_00126">[SWS_LinSM_00126]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00360" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00360">[SWS_LinIf_00360]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00544" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00544">[SWS_LinIf_00544]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_00234" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_00234">[SWS_Lin_00234]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00378" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00378">[SWS_LinIf_00378]</a></p>

<h4>पारस्परिक क्रिया और इंटरैक्शन पाथ्स</h4>
<p><strong>Master path.</strong> LinIf, <code>LinIf_MainFunction_&lt;LinIfChannel.ShortName&gt;</code> में schedule table को प्रोसेस करता है <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00384" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00384">[SWS_LinIf_00384]</a>। एक transmit slot इस प्रकार निष्पादित होता है:</p>
<ol>
<li>LinIf, <code>&lt;User_TriggerTransmit&gt;</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00528" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00528">[SWS_LinIf_00528]</a> के माध्यम से data प्राप्त करता है और उसे <code>Lin_SendFrame</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_00191" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_00191">[SWS_Lin_00191]</a> के साथ पास करता है।</li>
<li>यदि upper layer <code>E_NOT_OK</code> लौटाती है, तो frame नहीं भेजा जाता है <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00706" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00706">[SWS_LinIf_00706]</a>।</li>
<li>अधिकतम frame length के बाद ही सबसे पहले LinIf <code>Lin_GetStatus</code> के साथ status की क्वेरी करता है <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_00168" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_00168">[SWS_Lin_00168]</a> <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_LIN_SECTION_7_1_2_1_3_Status_check.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_LIN_SECTION_7_1_2_1_3_Status_check">LinIf-SWS पृ. 35</a>।</li>
<li><code>LIN_TX_ERROR</code> या <code>LIN_TX_BUSY</code> होने पर, <code>E_NOT_OK</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00728" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00728">[SWS_LinIf_00728]</a> के साथ <code>&lt;User_TxConfirmation&gt;</code> निष्पादित होता है।</li>
</ol>
<p>यदि upper layer PduR है, तो <code>&lt;User_TriggerTransmit&gt;</code> निश्चित होता है <code>PduR_LinIfTriggerTransmit</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00722" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00722">[SWS_LinIf_00722]</a>। <code>LinIf_Transmit</code> केवल sporadic (master) या event-triggered (slave) frames को शेड्यूल करता है <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00201" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00201">[SWS_LinIf_00201]</a> <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_LINIF_SECTION_8_2_3_LinIf_Transmit.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_LINIF_SECTION_8_2_3_LinIf_Transmit">LinIf-SWS पृ. 79</a>। <code>NULL_SCHEDULE</code> के तहत यह इसे अस्वीकार कर देता है <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00719" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00719">[SWS_LinIf_00719]</a>।</p>
<p><strong>Slave path.</strong> यह प्रक्रिया master के header द्वारा ट्रिगर की जाती है:</p>
<ol>
<li>Driver प्रत्येक header को PID और अपने buffer के pointer के साथ <code>LinIf_HeaderIndication</code> के माध्यम से रिपोर्ट करता है <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_00280" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_00280">[SWS_Lin_00280]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_91004" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_91004">[SWS_LinIf_91004]</a>।</li>
<li>LinIf PID का मूल्यांकन करता है:
<ul>
<li>एक transmit frame के मामले में, <code>&lt;User_TriggerTransmit&gt;</code> सीधे driver buffer में लिखता है <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00738" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00738">[SWS_LinIf_00738]</a>, और LinIf <code>Drc = LIN_FRAMERESPONSE_TX</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00739" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00739">[SWS_LinIf_00739]</a> सेट करता है।</li>
<li>Receive frames को <code>LIN_FRAMERESPONSE_RX</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00733" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00733">[SWS_LinIf_00733]</a> प्राप्त होता है।</li>
<li>Irrelevant frames को <code>LIN_FRAMERESPONSE_IGNORE</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00748" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00748">[SWS_LinIf_00748]</a> प्राप्त होता है।</li>
</ul></li>
<li>Lin <code>Drc</code>, <code>Cs</code> और <code>Dl</code> का मूल्यांकन करता है <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_00282" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_00282">[SWS_Lin_00282]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_00283" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_00283">[SWS_Lin_00283]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_00286" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_00286">[SWS_Lin_00286]</a>।</li>
<li>Lin प्रत्येक प्रासंगिक response को अगले header से पहले Rx-Indication, Tx-Confirmation या Error-Indication के साथ पूरा करता है <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_00285" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_00285">[SWS_Lin_00285]</a>।</li>
<li>LinIf परिणाम को क्रमशः <code>&lt;User_RxIndication&gt;</code> या <code>&lt;User_TxConfirmation&gt;</code> को आगे भेजता है <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00734" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00734">[SWS_LinIf_00734]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00741" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00741">[SWS_LinIf_00741]</a>।</li>
</ol>
<p>नए releases इन callouts को LSduR path (status DRAFT) <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_LINIF_SECTION_7_1_3_2_2_Response.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_LINIF_SECTION_7_1_3_2_2_Response">LinIf-SWS पृ. 43</a> से बदल देते हैं। R20-11 के लिए <code>&lt;User_…&gt;</code> interfaces लागू होते हैं।</p>

<p class="diagram-note">Sequence diagram: एक slave अपनी response केवल header indication, upper layer द्वारा buffer भरे जाने और <code>Drc</code> के माध्यम से release के बाद ही भेजता है। स्रोत: <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_00280" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_00280">[SWS_Lin_00280]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00738" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00738">[SWS_LinIf_00738]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00739" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00739">[SWS_LinIf_00739]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_00283" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_00283">[SWS_Lin_00283]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00742" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00742">[SWS_LinIf_00742]</a> <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../spec/figures/FIG-cdd2c11b1b58cfea.html" data-snip="FIG-cdd2c11b1b58cfea">LinIf-SWS पृ. 121</a></p>
<p><strong>Transport protocol और schedule change.</strong> <code>LinTp_Transmit</code> एक TP message तैयार करता है <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00351" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00351">[SWS_LinIf_00351]</a>। Master में, LinTp <code>LinTp_Mode</code> के साथ <code>BswM_LinTp_RequestMode</code> के माध्यम से schedule change का अनुरोध करता है <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00360" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00360">[SWS_LinIf_00360]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00629" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00629">[SWS_LinIf_00629]</a>। फिर यह श्रृंखला इस प्रकार चलती है <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_BSWM_SECTION_9_6_Transport_Protocol_message_transmission.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_BSWM_SECTION_9_6_Transport_Protocol_message_transmission">LinIf-SWS पृ. 132</a>:</p>
<ol>
<li>BswM <code>LinSM_ScheduleRequest</code> को कॉल करता है <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_00113" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_00113">[SWS_LinSM_00113]</a>।</li>
<li>LinSM <code>LinIf_ScheduleRequest</code> को कॉल करता है <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00202" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00202">[SWS_LinIf_00202]</a>।</li>
<li>LinIf <code>&lt;User&gt;_ScheduleRequestConfirmation</code> के माध्यम से <code>LinSM_ScheduleRequestConfirmation</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00520" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00520">[SWS_LinIf_00520]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_00129" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_00129">[SWS_LinSM_00129]</a> को पुष्टि करता है।</li>
</ol>
<p>इन APIs के parameter names को R22-11 <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_CLASSICPLATFORMRELEASEOVERVIEW_SECTION_00202_LinIf_ScheduleRequest_and_schedule.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_CLASSICPLATFORMRELEASEOVERVIEW_SECTION_00202_LinIf_ScheduleRequest_and_schedule">Release Overview पृ. 50</a> में बदल दिया गया था। R20-11 में उन्हें अभी भी <code>Schedule</code>/<code>schedule</code> कहा जाता है।</p>

<h4>सिंक्रोनाइज़ेशन, री-एंट्रेंसी और टास्क संदर्भ</h4>
<p><strong>Cyclic processing.</strong> प्रति channel एक <code>LinIf_MainFunction_&lt;LinIfChannel.ShortName&gt;</code> मौजूद होती है। अन्य LinIf APIs जैसे <code>LinIf_GotoSleep</code>, <code>LinIf_Transmit</code>, <code>LinIf_ScheduleRequest</code> और <code>LinIf_Wakeup</code> इसे बाधित कर सकती हैं। इसलिए साझा किए गए क्षेत्रों को संरक्षित किया जाना चाहिए <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_LINIF_SECTION_8_4_1_LinIf_MainFunction__LinIfChannel_ShortName.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_LINIF_SECTION_8_4_1_LinIf_MainFunction__LinIfChannel_ShortName">LinIf-SWS पृ. 119</a>। <code>LinSM_MainFunction</code> timeout timers को बनाए रखता है <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_00156" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_00156">[SWS_LinSM_00156]</a>।</p>
<p><strong>Direct calls.</strong> Sleep transitions जानबूझकर अगली MainFunction की प्रतीक्षा नहीं करते हैं। इस प्रकार वे caller के context में चलते हैं:</p>
<ul>
<li>LinSM <code>LinIf_GotoSleep</code> को तुरंत कॉल करता है <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_00036" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_00036">[SWS_LinSM_00036]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_00231" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_00231">[SWS_LinSM_00231]</a>।</li>
<li>LinIf <code>Lin_GoToSleepInternal</code> को तुरंत कॉल करता है <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00757" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00757">[SWS_LinIf_00757]</a>।</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Slave callbacks.</strong> ये callbacks विभिन्न channels के लिए reentrant हैं, लेकिन समान channel के लिए नहीं <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_91005" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_91005">[SWS_LinIf_91005]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_91006" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_91006">[SWS_LinIf_91006]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_91007" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_91007">[SWS_LinIf_91007]</a>। आरेख में, <code>LinIf_HeaderIndication</code> सीधे hardware interrupt <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../spec/figures/FIG-cdd2c11b1b58cfea.html" data-snip="FIG-cdd2c11b1b58cfea">LinIf-SWS पृ. 121</a> का अनुसरण करता है। Interpretation: इस प्रकार callbacks अधिकतर ISR context में चलने की संभावना है। इसलिए <code>&lt;User_TriggerTransmit&gt;</code> को संक्षिप्त रहना चाहिए। Driver स्वयं non-blocking रूप से भेजता और प्राप्त करता है <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_LINIF_SECTION_7_4_2_3_Common.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_LINIF_SECTION_7_4_2_3_Common">Lin-SWS पृ. 28</a>।</p>
<p><strong>R20-11 में Reentrancy.</strong> R20-11 <code>Lin_GoToSleep</code>, <code>Lin_Wakeup</code> और <code>Lin_GetStatus</code> को “Non Reentrant” घोषित करता है <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_00166" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_00166">[SWS_Lin_00166]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_00169" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_00169">[SWS_Lin_00169]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_00168" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_00168">[SWS_Lin_00168]</a>। नए दस्तावेज़ विभिन्न channels के लिए reentrancy की अनुमति देते हैं <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_LIN_SECTION_8_3_2_2_Lin_GoToSleep.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_LIN_SECTION_8_3_2_2_Lin_GoToSleep">Lin-SWS पृ. 43</a>। R20-11 के लिए सख्त संस्करण मानक है।</p>
<p>Transceiver के मामले में भी एक समान अंतर मौजूद है: <code>LinIf_SetTrcvMode</code> reentrant है <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00544" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00544">[SWS_LinIf_00544]</a>, लेकिन कॉल किया गया <code>LinTrcv_SetOpMode</code> नहीं है <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinTrcv_00002" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinTrcv_00002">[SWS_LinTrcv_00002]</a>। Interpretation: Integration को समवर्ती कॉलों को क्रमबद्ध करना चाहिए।</p>
<p><strong>Multicore.</strong> Channel और transceiver channel का एक ही ECUC partition से संबंधित होना आवश्यक है <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_CONSTR_00279" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_CONSTR_00279">[SWS_Lin_CONSTR_00279]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinTrcv_00177" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinTrcv_00177">[SWS_LinTrcv_00177]</a>।</p>

<h4>जीवनचक्र और ऑपरेटिंग मोड्स</h4>
<p><strong>Initialization.</strong> Mode management guide <code>Lin_Init</code>, <code>LinIf_Init</code>, <code>LinSM_Init</code>, <code>LinTp_Init</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_00006" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_00006">[SWS_Lin_00006]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00198" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00198">[SWS_LinIf_00198]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_00155" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_00155">[SWS_LinSM_00155]</a> <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_MODEMANAGEMENTGUIDE_SECTION_4_1_Startup.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_MODEMANAGEMENTGUIDE_SECTION_4_1_Startup">ModeManagementGuide पृ. 54</a> के क्रम में initialize करता है। <code>LinTrcv_Init</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinTrcv_00001" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinTrcv_00001">[SWS_LinTrcv_00001]</a> की स्थिति संदर्भ से स्पष्ट नहीं होती है। इस प्रक्रिया में modules निम्नलिखित प्रारंभिक अवस्थाएँ सेट करते हैं:</p>
<ul>
<li><code>LinIf_Init</code> master में <code>NULL_SCHEDULE</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00197" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00197">[SWS_LinIf_00197]</a> <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_LINIF_SECTION_8_2_1_LinIf_Init.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_LINIF_SECTION_8_2_1_LinIf_Init">LinIf-SWS पृ. 90</a> सेट करता है।</li>
<li><code>LinTp_Init</code> प्रत्येक channel को <code>LINTP_CHANNEL_IDLE</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00710" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00710">[SWS_LinIf_00710]</a> पर सेट करता है।</li>
<li>LinSM, ComM या BswM को सूचित किए बिना <code>LINSM_NO_COM</code> में शुरू होता है <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_COMM_SECTION_7_1_3_LINSM_NO_COM.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_COMM_SECTION_7_1_3_LINSM_NO_COM">LinSM-SWS पृ. 23</a>।</li>
</ul>

<p class="diagram-note">State diagram: LinSM communication modes और driver की LIN channel states; <code>LIN_CH_SLEEP_PENDING</code> केवल master में मौजूद है। स्रोत: <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_00220" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_00220">[SWS_LinSM_00220]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_00301" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_00301">[SWS_LinSM_00301]</a> <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_LINIF_SECTION_7_1_5_Goto_sleep.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_LINIF_SECTION_7_1_5_Goto_sleep">LinSM-SWS पृ. 24</a> <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../spec/figures/FIG-62a72d6cdb5e7a82.html" data-snip="FIG-62a72d6cdb5e7a82">Lin-SWS पृ. 23</a> <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_LIN_SECTION_8_2_7_Lin_StatusType.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_LIN_SECTION_8_2_7_Lin_StatusType">Lin-SWS पृ. 37</a></p>
<p><strong>Master में Sleep.</strong> यदि ComM <code>COMM_NO_COMMUNICATION</code> का अनुरोध करता है, तो LinSM <code>LinIf_GotoSleep</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_10208" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_10208">[SWS_LinSM_10208]</a> को कॉल करता है। LinIf फिर <code>Lin_GoToSleep</code> के माध्यम से go-to-sleep command भेजता है। त्रुटि होने की स्थिति में भी channel <code>LIN_CH_SLEEP_PENDING</code> <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_LIN_SECTION_8_3_2_2_Lin_GoToSleep.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_LIN_SECTION_8_3_2_2_Lin_GoToSleep">Lin-SWS पृ. 43</a> पर चला जाता है। पुष्टिकरण LinSM तक <code>LinSM_GotoSleepConfirmation</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_00135" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_00135">[SWS_LinSM_00135]</a> के रूप में पहुँचता है।</p>

<p class="diagram-note">Sequence diagram: Sleep अनुरोध को synchronous रूप से स्वीकार किया जाता है, लेकिन command केवल अगली LinIf MainFunction में भेजी जाती है और asynchronous रूप से पुष्टि की जाती है। स्रोत: <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_00036" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_00036">[SWS_LinSM_00036]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_00135" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_00135">[SWS_LinSM_00135]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00521" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00521">[SWS_LinIf_00521]</a> <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../spec/figures/FIG-2898b765ed0e054b.html" data-snip="FIG-2898b765ed0e054b">LinSM-SWS पृ. 47</a> <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../spec/figures/FIG-51b4cb14f4361f7b.html" data-snip="FIG-51b4cb14f4361f7b">LinIf-SWS पृ. 93</a></p>
<p><strong>Slave में Sleep.</strong> दो घटनाएं इस संक्रमण को शुरू करती हैं: NAD 0 <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00750" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00750">[SWS_LinIf_00750]</a> के साथ एक MRF या एक bus-idle timeout <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00755" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00755">[SWS_LinIf_00755]</a>। LinIf दोनों को <code>LinSM_GotoSleepIndication</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00756" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00756">[SWS_LinIf_00756]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_91000" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_91000">[SWS_LinSM_91000]</a> के माध्यम से रिपोर्ट करता है। आगे की प्रक्रिया <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_LINIF_SECTION_7_4_2_2_3_Sleep_mode_transition.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_LINIF_SECTION_7_4_2_2_3_Sleep_mode_transition">LinIf-SWS पृ. 55</a>:</p>
<ol>
<li>LinSM <code>LinIf_GotoSleep</code> को कॉल करता है।</li>
<li>LinIf <code>Lin_GoToSleepInternal</code> के माध्यम से driver को sleep में डालता है और <code>TRUE</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00759" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00759">[SWS_LinIf_00759]</a> के साथ पुष्टि करता है।</li>
<li>यदि ComM ने पहले <code>COMM_NO_COMMUNICATION</code> का अनुरोध किया था <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_00230" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_00230">[SWS_LinSM_00230]</a>, तो ComM को <code>ComM_BusSM_BusSleepMode</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_00233" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_00233">[SWS_LinSM_00233]</a> प्राप्त होता है।</li>
<li>अन्यथा LinSM wakeup प्रक्रिया को फिर से शुरू करता है <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_00234" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_00234">[SWS_LinSM_00234]</a>।</li>
</ol>
<p>वैकल्पिक रूप से transceiver को <code>LinIf_SetTrcvMode(LINTRCV_TRCV_MODE_SLEEP)</code> के माध्यम से भी स्विच किया जाता है <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_00138" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_00138">[SWS_LinSM_00138]</a> <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../spec/figures/FIG-800f4599841c569c.html" data-snip="FIG-800f4599841c569c">LinIf-SWS पृ. 137</a>।</p>
<p><strong>ComM द्वारा Wakeup प्रक्रिया।</strong> <code>COMM_FULL_COMMUNICATION</code> पर LinSM एक confirmation timer शुरू करता है और <code>LinIf_Wakeup</code> को सीधे कॉल करता है <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_BSWM_SECTION_7_1_7_Wake_up_process.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_BSWM_SECTION_7_1_7_Wake_up_process">LinSM-SWS पृ. 27</a> <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_LINIF_SECTION_7_1_8_Timeout_of_requests.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_LINIF_SECTION_7_1_8_Timeout_of_requests">LinSM-SWS पृ. 27</a>। एक चालू silence-after-wakeup timer इस कॉल में देरी करता है <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_00237" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_00237">[SWS_LinSM_00237]</a>। LinIf wakeup flag के आधार पर निर्णय लेता है:</p>
<ul>
<li>यदि flag सेट नहीं है, तो LinIf wakeup pulse के साथ <code>Lin_Wakeup</code> को कॉल करता है <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00205" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00205">[SWS_LinIf_00205]</a> <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_LINIF_SECTION_8_2_6_LinIf_Wakeup.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_LINIF_SECTION_8_2_6_LinIf_Wakeup">LinIf-SWS पृ. 89</a>।</li>
<li>यदि flag सेट है, तो बिना pulse के <code>Lin_WakeupInternal</code> पर्याप्त होना चाहिए <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_00262" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_00262">[SWS_Lin_00262]</a>।</li>
</ul>
<p>एक slave पहले प्राप्त header पर ही wakeup की पुष्टि करता है <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00761" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00761">[SWS_LinIf_00761]</a>।</p>
<p><strong>External wakeup events.</strong> EcuM <code>LinIf_CheckWakeup</code> को कॉल करता है। स्रोत के आधार पर LinIf <code>Lin_CheckWakeup</code> या <code>LinTrcv_CheckWakeup</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00378" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00378">[SWS_LinIf_00378]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_00160" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_00160">[SWS_Lin_00160]</a> पर शाखाबद्ध होता है। पहचाने गए event की रिपोर्ट drivers द्वारा EcuM को और <code>LinIf_WakeupConfirmation</code> के माध्यम से LinIf <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00715" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00715">[SWS_LinIf_00715]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinTrcv_91002" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinTrcv_91002">[SWS_LinTrcv_91002]</a> <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_LINIF_SECTION_8_3_1_2_Lin_CheckWakeup.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_LINIF_SECTION_8_3_1_2_Lin_CheckWakeup">Lin-SWS पृ. 42</a> को दी जाती है। Transceiver की wake notification को <code>LinIf_SetTrcvWakeupMode</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00550" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00550">[SWS_LinIf_00550]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinTrcv_00169" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinTrcv_00169">[SWS_LinTrcv_00169]</a> नियंत्रित करता है।</p>

<h4>त्रुटि प्रबंधन, DET-ट्रेसिंग और डिग्रेडेशन</h4>
<p><strong>Development errors (DET).</strong> सभी modules DET के विरुद्ध parameters और initialization state की जांच करते हैं:</p>
<ul>
<li>LinIf: <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00376" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00376">[SWS_LinIf_00376]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00849" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00849">[SWS_LinIf_00849]</a></li>
<li>Lin, आदि <code>LIN_E_STATE_TRANSITION</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_00258" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_00258">[SWS_Lin_00258]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_00260" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_00260">[SWS_Lin_00260]</a></li>
<li>LinSM: <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_00053" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_00053">[SWS_LinSM_00053]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_00240" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_00240">[SWS_LinSM_00240]</a></li>
<li>LinTrcv: <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinTrcv_00005" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinTrcv_00005">[SWS_LinTrcv_00005]</a> <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_LINTRCV_SECTION_8_3_3_LinTrcv_GetOpMode.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_LINTRCV_SECTION_8_3_3_LinTrcv_GetOpMode">LinTrcv-SWS पृ. 26</a></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Runtime errors.</strong> Lin को अनिवार्य रूप से <code>Dem_SetEventStatus</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_00234" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_00234">[SWS_Lin_00234]</a> की आवश्यकता होती है। Driver hardware timeouts को <code>LIN_E_TIMEOUT</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_00290" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_00290">[SWS_Lin_00290]</a> के रूप में रिपोर्ट करता है। Slave में Lin त्रुटियों को <code>Lin_SlaveErrorType</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_91140" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_91140">[SWS_Lin_91140]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_00277" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_00277">[SWS_Lin_00277]</a> के रूप में प्रदान करता है। LinIf फिर response को lost के रूप में मूल्यांकित करता है और <code>LIN_ERR_HEADER</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00735" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00735">[SWS_LinIf_00735]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00729" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00729">[SWS_LinIf_00729]</a> को छोड़कर <code>LINIF_E_RESPONSE</code> की रिपोर्ट करता है। LinSM अनुपस्थित callbacks को <code>LINSM_E_CONFIRMATION_TIMEOUT</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_00224" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_00224">[SWS_LinSM_00224]</a> के रूप में रिपोर्ट करता है।</p>
<p><strong>Degradation.</strong> कई तंत्र त्रुटियों के बाद संचालन को व्यवस्थित रूप से बनाए रखते हैं:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>response_error signal:</strong> Response त्रुटियां <code>Com_SendSignal</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00744" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00744">[SWS_LinIf_00744]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00764" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00764">[SWS_LinIf_00764]</a> के माध्यम से signal सेट करती हैं। सफल प्रसारण के बाद इसे रीसेट कर दिया जाता है <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00747" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00747">[SWS_LinIf_00747]</a> <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_LIN_SECTION_7_5_Status_Management.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_LIN_SECTION_7_5_Status_Management">LinIf-SWS पृ. 58</a>।</li>
<li><strong>LinSM consistency:</strong> <code>E_NOT_OK</code> पर, LinSM पिछली स्थिति को पुनः सेट करता है ताकि ComM और BswM को एक indication प्राप्त हो <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_00177" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_00177">[SWS_LinSM_00177]</a>।</li>
<li><strong>LinTp aborts:</strong> N_As या N_Cr timeout होने पर LinTp निरस्त हो जाता है और PduR <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00801" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00801">[SWS_LinIf_00801]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00806" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00806">[SWS_LinIf_00806]</a> को <code>E_NOT_OK</code> रिपोर्ट करता है।</li>
<li><strong>Buffer shortage:</strong> यदि receive buffer की कमी होती है, तो LinTp SRF headers को निलंबित कर देता है <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00679" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00679">[SWS_LinIf_00679]</a>। वैकल्पिक रूप से, यह निरस्त करते हुए application schedule पर वापस लौटता है <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00792" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00792">[SWS_LinIf_00792]</a> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00879" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00879">[SWS_LinIf_00879]</a>।</li>
<li><strong>Node Configuration:</strong> N_As timeout <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00786" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00786">[SWS_LinIf_00786]</a> पर LinIf एक लंबित response को छोड़ देता है।</li>
</ul>

(autosar.org)।
यह AUTOSAR का आधिकारिक प्रकाशन नहीं है; वर्णनात्मक पाठ मूल (अंग्रेज़ी) में हैं।
